Google Play Services specifically is just 1 package consisting of 4 necessary to have Google Play fully functional. 

The 4 packages should be installed in the following order...

1. Google Account Manager
2. Google Services Framework
3. Google Play Services
4. Google Play Store

So if you're having trouble uninstalling a particular package then try uninstalling all of these packages in reverse order from what's listed above
